description: This Java class implements a service for integrating with ThitsaWorks Credit Bureau API, including methods for obtaining credit reports, uploading reports, token management, and handling API responses.

classes.name: ThitsaWorksCreditBureauIntegrationWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing credit bureau integration functionalities such as fetching and uploading credit reports, token management, and API response handling.

methods.name: okHttpConnectionMethod
methods.description: Performs HTTP requests to external credit bureau API endpoints, supporting different processes like report upload, report retrieval, token acquisition, and NRC validation.

methods.name: getCreditReportFromThitsaWorks
methods.description: Fetches credit report data from ThitsaWorks API based on NRC and credit bureau ID, processes JSON response to extract borrower info and credit scores.

methods.name: addCreditReport
methods.description: Uploads a credit report file to the credit bureau API.

methods.name: extractUniqueId
methods.description: Parses JSON response to extract a unique report ID or handle multiple NRC entries.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Manages creation and refresh of access tokens for credit bureau API authentication.

methods.name: getCreditBureauConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves specific configuration parameters for a given credit bureau ID from the repository.
